hero.subtitle: Road Foundation Layers
hero.srOnly: in Doha, Qatar — Road Foundation, Base Course & Pavement Layer Contractor
hero.description: CPC Qatar builds strong, lasting road foundations through expert subgrade preparation, subbase installation, and base course construction. Proper foundation layers are critical for pavement longevity — we get them right every time.

layer1.title: Subgrade
layer1.desc: The natural soil foundation. We prepare the subgrade by grading to design levels, treating weak soils (lime or cement stabilization), and compacting to 95%+ MDD. We perform CBR testing and proof rolling to verify bearing capacity before proceeding.

layer2.title: Capping Layer
layer2.desc: Where the natural subgrade is weak, we install a capping layer of select granular material to improve bearing capacity. Placed in controlled lifts and compacted to specification.

layer3.title: Subbase Course
layer3.desc: Crushed aggregate subbase installed on the prepared subgrade. CPC places subbase in specified lift thicknesses (typically 150-200mm) with controlled compaction to 98%+ MDD. Material is tested for gradation, plasticity, and CBR value.

layer4.title: Road Base Course
layer4.desc: The main structural layer beneath the asphalt. We install crushed rock or stabilized base course at design thickness with precise level control and high compaction. This layer distributes traffic loads to the layers below.

testingSection.title: Material Testing & Quality Control
testingSection.description: Every layer is tested before, during, and after placement to ensure compliance with project specifications and QCS standards.

test1.title: Compaction Testing
test1.desc: Nuclear density gauge and sand replacement tests to verify in-situ density meets minimum 95-100% MDD requirement.

test2.title: CBR Testing
test2.desc: California Bearing Ratio testing of subgrade and subbase materials to confirm adequate bearing capacity.

test3.title: Gradation Analysis
test3.desc: Sieve analysis of aggregate materials to ensure proper particle size distribution per specification.

test4.title: Atterberg Limits
test4.desc: Liquid limit and plastic limit testing of soil materials to check plasticity index compliance.

test5.title: Proctor Testing
test5.desc: Standard and modified Proctor tests to determine maximum dry density and optimum moisture content.

test6.title: Level Survey
test6.desc: Continuous level monitoring using total station and GPS to verify layer thickness and finished levels.

seoSection.title: Subgrade & Subbase Contractor in Qatar
seoSection.p1: CPC Qatar has extensive experience building road foundation layers for projects across Qatar. A properly constructed subgrade and subbase is the most important factor in road pavement life — even the best asphalt will fail on a weak foundation.
seoSection.p2: Our teams work with third-party testing laboratories to verify every layer meets design requirements. We maintain detailed records of compaction test results, material certifications, and level surveys for project documentation and client assurance.
seoSection.p3: We operate across all areas of Qatar including Doha, Lusail, Al Wakrah, Al Khor, Al Rayyan, and Al Shahaniya, delivering road foundation works on schedule and to specification.

roadMarking.intro: CPC Qatar provides professional road marking and traffic sign installation services throughout Qatar. From thermoplastic line marking to reflective traffic signs, we enhance road safety and traffic management with precision and compliance to Ashghal standards.

thermoplastic.title: Thermoplastic Road Marking
thermoplastic.description: Hot-applied thermoplastic markings for center lines, edge lines, crosswalks, arrows, and symbols. High retroreflectivity with glass beads for night visibility. Long-lasting and suitable for high-traffic roads.

coldPaint.title: Cold Paint Road Marking
coldPaint.description: Solvent-based and water-based cold paint for internal roads, parking lots, and temporary markings. Quick drying and cost-effective for lighter traffic applications.

signs.title: Traffic Sign Installation
signs.description: Manufacturing and installation of regulatory, warning, and informational traffic signs. Reflective sheeting (diamond grade and high-intensity grade) per Qatar Traffic Manual standards.

striping.title: Lane Striping & Delineation
striping.description: Precision lane striping for multi-lane highways, roundabouts, intersections, and merging zones. Raised pavement markers (RPMs) and road studs for enhanced delineation.

parking.title: Parking Lot Marking
parking.description: Complete parking area marking including stall lines, directional arrows, handicap symbols, fire lane markings, speed bumps, and numbering systems.

safety.title: Road Safety Elements
safety.description: Installation of guardrails, delineator posts, chevron signs, speed bumps, bollards, and other road safety furniture to improve traffic management.

meta.title: Subgrade & Subbase Works for Roads in Qatar | CPC Qatar
meta.description: Subgrade preparation, subbase installation & base course construction in Doha, Qatar. Material testing, compaction control and QCS compliance.

subgrade.intro: CPC Qatar builds strong, lasting road foundations through expert subgrade preparation, subbase installation, and base course construction. Proper foundation layers are critical for pavement longevity — we get them right every time.

subgrade.title: Subgrade
subgrade.description: The natural soil foundation. We prepare the subgrade by grading to design levels, treating weak soils (lime or cement stabilization), and compacting to 95%+ MDD. We perform CBR testing and proof rolling to verify bearing capacity before proceeding.

capping.title: Capping Layer
capping.description: Where the natural subgrade is weak, we install a capping layer of select granular material to improve bearing capacity. Placed in controlled lifts and compacted to specification.

subbase.title: Subbase Course
subbase.description: Crushed aggregate subbase installed on the prepared subgrade. CPC places subbase in specified lift thicknesses (typically 150-200mm) with controlled compaction to 98%+ MDD. Material is tested for gradation, plasticity, and CBR value.

base.title: Road Base Course
base.description: The main structural layer beneath the asphalt. We install crushed rock or stabilized base course at design thickness with precise level control and high compaction. This layer distributes traffic loads to the layers below.

testing.title: Material Testing & Quality Control
testing.description: Every layer is tested before, during, and after placement to ensure compliance with project specifications and QCS standards.

cta.description: Contact CPC Qatar for professional road foundation construction services.

safety.title: 6. HEALTH & SAFETY POLICY
safety.intro: CPC strives to attain and maintain the highest possible level of safety practices on all CPC projects. CPC aims to achieve this through the implementation of the following:

operational.title: 1) OPERATIONAL SAFETY
operational.content: The Company and its employees are dedicated towards making sure that all operations are monitored for safety and are conducted and executed in the safest manner possible.

compliance.title: 2) COMPLIANCE
compliance.content: CPC will at all times comply with all Government Laws, Regulations and Company policies and procedures that have been established.

measures.title: 3) SAFETY MEASURES
measures.content: Assess potential risks and hazards and develop safety measures to counteract these problems.

emergency.title: 4) RESPONSE TO EMERGENCIES
emergency.content: Safety awareness programs, safety drills and exercises must be conducted.

community.title: 5) COMMUNITY AWARENESS & OUTREACH
community.content: Encourage open communication and understanding between CPC and the community, this includes recognizing and responding as appropriate to community concerns about safety issues.

safety.commitment: This policy needs the commitment and support of each employee and sub-contractors. Management and supervisors at every level are requested to demonstrate dedication to the safety policy by means of informing and creating awareness of the policy to all employees and giving them the responsibility and resources to address safety issues that may be encountered.

quality.title: 7. QUALITY POLICY
quality.intro: CPC Co. is committed to supplying construction services of consistent quality that conform fully with company and statutory requirements and in meeting our client's documented and implied expectations in terms of technical, budget and time compliance.
quality.dedicated: Dedicated to the continual review, development and improvement of all aspects of its business, in particular:

items.development: The development and improvement of the Company's construction services in line with client's needs and expectations.
items.system: The development of an efficient and effective Quality System and generally accepted best practices in the management of Construction Projects, a system which not only ensures that the construction quality is consistent, but also helps to ensure minimal wastage in all our construction phases.
items.training: The evaluation, training and development of our employees in order to meet the company's objectives.
items.culture: The ongoing development of the corporate culture that incorporates constant problem solving and continuous improvement, encouraging all employees to take total pride in, and responsibility for, their work and the development of better working practices.
items.objectives: Establishing and reviewing quality objectives for all levels that are realistic, achievable and measurable taking into cognizance preventive action for outside influences that could prevent the achievement of the objectives.

quality.management: Management will communicate this policy to all employees and staff in such a way that it is properly understood and followed.

contact.title: 8. CONTACT US
contact.content: Questions about this policy? Contact us:

consent.title: CONSENT
consent.content: This is a simple presentation website. We only collect what you voluntarily submit through our contact form, and we use it solely to respond to your inquiry.
